Subject: Request: temporary credits for POC burst / latency validation

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput looked promising. Our infra team wants to run a controlled load window to validate tail latency at ~1k concurrent rps for 15 minutes (end-to-end with prewarm + KV cache off) against the model variant you showed.

Can Redwood provision an additional 250k free credits on our trial account so we can run 2-3 burst windows this month? We need the tokens to simulate 1M tokens total across the test.

If you need a formal MA (mutual action) or statement of work, I can loop procurement, but for now a short-term test credit would unblock us.

Attaching a short test checklist (will follow with a formal test plan if you want).

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
VP Product
Nova Retail

Alex — thanks for the note and great to hear the demo sparked the right questions.

Short answer: we can usually accommodate a temporary burst credit grant for POCs, but I need sign-off from sales ops (Monica) on the amount and a quick test plan to avoid accidental quota consumption. A few clarifying questions so we size this correctly:

- Target RPS and average prompt length vs expected token per response (you mentioned ~1M tokens total, can you confirm split between input/output?).
- Are you testing with prefix caching disabled (you said KV cache off) and using batch size configuration X? If you need us to reserve burst GPUs we can do that but it consumes credits faster.
- Timeline: you requested this month — which dates are you planning? We prefer 24-48 hour windows we can monitor.

If you can send the short PoC test plan I’ll route to Monica for approval. If approved, we normally grant a time-limited credit package and a one-off SLA monitoring window.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Alex — I reviewed the ask. I can authorize a time-limited promotional credit grant but with the following constraints:

1) We will provide 200,000 promo tokens (an additional grant beyond their trial) scoped to a 72-hour window starting on the agreed test date.
2) Nova must run the planned validation during that window and share the PoC-load-test-plan.pdf and token-usage-estimate.xlsx (for our post-test audit).
3) If they need reserved capacity (dedicated GPUs for guaranteed tail latency), that will require a dedicated capacity addendum — not covered by promo credits.

Operational notes for Rishi / Karthik: please enable detailed tracing for that account during the window and set an alert rule (latency_p95 > 300ms) to notify ops. Also add a one-off config to increase max concurrent workers to avoid throttling unrelated to token budget.

Alex — let me know the exact 72-hour window you prefer. Once you confirm, I’ll issue the credit and share the DocuSign link for simple confirmation of terms (we require a short acceptance to track promo grants).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
